The Adjustment Factors shall be applicable at peak, shoulder and off peak time of use periods.
The Adjustment Factors and the Resultant Retail Tariffs are determined taking into account the cost allocation across the different customer categories. The detailed Tariff Order is available at www.era.or.ug.
This Schedule of Tariffs for the third quarter of 2016 shall be applicable to all consumer bills raised based on meter readings and Yaka purchases taken in the period July 2016 to September 2016.
